notes.title: Introducing Our New Game, and Notice About Price Adjustment for Black Dream Plus
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/defc4847c8a5786e5df1a07222c89c47174236a6.png[/img]


[b]<Introducing New Game in Development>[/b]

We are Introducing <Break Wolf>, a new game currently in development.

<Break Wolf> will support 3 languages upon release. (Korean / English / Japanese)

The estimated release date is about January 2024.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gab8LTdk8kw





[b]<Notice About Price Adjustment>[/b]

In order to match price with our future games in development,
we'll be making the following adjustments to the price and discounts for <Black Dream Plus> after 3 months from now.


[Current Price]
Black Dream Plus: 8.99 USD normally, 50% discount during Steam sale events

[Price Adjustment After 3 Months]
Black Dream Plus: 6.99 USD normally, 40%~50% discount during Steam sale events



Thank you.

notes.title: Notification about playing Classic version of Black Dream
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32338789/570afd6e53059324e0e166476117d4ba3653b8c1.png[/img]

Since <Black Dream> has upgraded to <Black Dream Plus>,
Plus version will be typically installed to your hard drive.

But if you are still willing to play Classic version,
you can download past version of <Black Dream> via Steam client.



[b]* How to select game version[/b]

If you follow the steps below, Classic version of <Black Dream> will be installed at the game folder.
[i]Steam Client Library ▶ Right-click "Black Dream" ▶ Properties ▶ Betas ▶ Select "classic eng"[/i]

If you want to reinstall Plus version, please follow the steps below.
[i]Steam Client Library ▶ Right-click "Black Dream" ▶ Properties ▶ Betas ▶ Select "none"[/i]



[b]* Caution about save files of each versions[/b]

Each save files of <Black Dream> and <Black Dream Plus> are not compatible,
so the game may crash when you try to load a save file from the another version.

For this reason, you have to backup save files if you're switching game versions.

Save files are saved to the directory where the game is installed,
and they're named as "Save**.lsd". (**: Number between 01-15)
